parameters.query: UPDATE artifacts SET assessment_status='processing', assessment_attempts=assessment_attempts+1, last_attempted_at=NOW() WHERE id='{{ $json.body.artifact_id }}'::uuid RETURNING id, program_control_id

SELECT cd.nist_id, cd.requirement_text, cd.assessment_objective, cd.acceptable_proof_guidance, cd.cmmc_id, pc.program_id FROM control_definitions cd JOIN program_controls pc ON pc.control_definition_id = cd.id WHERE pc.id='{{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.program_control_id }}'::uuid

parameters.bodyParametersJson: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openrouter/auto', max_tokens: 2000, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are a CMMC Level 2 compliance assessor with expertise in NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2. Assess whether submitted evidence artifacts satisfy the given security control requirement. Be precise, objective, and thorough. Always respond with valid JSON only.' }, { role: 'user', content: $json.prompt }] }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO assessments (artifact_id, program_control_id, verdict, confidence, rationale, gaps, model_used) VALUES ('{{ $json.artifact_id }}'::uuid, '{{ $json.program_control_id }}'::uuid, '{{ $json.verdict }}', {{ $json.confidence }}::numeric, '{{ $json.rationale }}', '{{ $json.gaps }}'::jsonb, '{{ $json.model_used }}') RETURNING id::text AS assessment_id, artifact_id::text, program_control_id::text, verdict

UPDATE artifacts SET assessment_status='assessed', extracted_text='{{ $('Parse Claude Response').first().json.extracted_text }}' WHERE id='{{ $('Parse Claude Response').first().json.artifact_id }}'::uuid RETURNING id::text AS artifact_id
UPDATE program_controls SET status='fully_implemented', updated_at=NOW() WHERE id='{{ $('Parse Claude Response').first().json.program_control_id }}'::uuid RETURNING id::text AS program_control_id
UPDATE program_controls SET status='implementation_begun', updated_at=NOW() WHERE id='{{ $('Parse Claude Response').first().json.program_control_id }}'::uuid RETURNING id::text AS program_control_id

INSERT INTO activity_log (program_id, event_type, entity_type, entity_id, description, metadata) VALUES ('{{ $('Parse Claude Response').first().json.program_id }}'::uuid, 'assessment_complete', 'artifact', '{{ $('Parse Claude Response').first().json.artifact_id }}'::uuid, '{{ "Artifact assessed: " + $('Parse Claude Response').first().json.verdict }}', '{"verdict":"{{ $('Parse Claude Response').first().json.verdict }}"}'::jsonb) RETURNING id::text AS log_id

parameters.bodyParametersJson: ={{ JSON.stringify({ artifact_id: $('Parse Claude Response').first().json.artifact_id, program_control_id: $('Parse Claude Response').first().json.program_control_id, verdict: $('Parse Claude Response').first().json.verdict, confidence: $('Parse Claude Response').first().json.confidence, rationale: $('Parse Claude Response').first().json.rationale, gaps: JSON.parse($('Parse Claude Response').first().json.gaps || '[]'), model_used: $('Parse Claude Response').first().json.model_used, secret: $env.WEBHOOK_SECRET}) }}
